meaning: Public reconciled project planning joins the existing checked composition binding plan to the same full native project without reinterpreting authored behavior.
inputs: Retain the explicit reconciled compilation selection, every existing node/factory/Operation/Workflow binding and whole-project checks. Use compiler-bundled integration and composition-binding definitions. Do not remove compositions to bypass input checks.
generation: Preserve the registered R07 domain artifact plan. Add the exact registered composition artifacts and adapter modules, retain provenance and all core binding information in the project plan, and reject unsupported targets or combined path/import collisions before output writes.
views: Whole-project source and snapshot builds include every domain and composition artifact in one deterministic inventory. Node views contain only the selected domain modules and their transitive native imports, not reverse dependants or application compositions. The explicit application layout relocates the complete view by one common prefix without rewriting content or import specifiers.
effects: Planning, artifact-currentness verification and local output remain separate. No HTTP server, provider, factory or authored behavior runs during planning or output. Record binding remains structural; domain factory selections remain independently explicit.
verification: Public output receipts account for every composition artifact and detect missing, changed and surplus output. Until the stronger verifier covers composition behavior and mixed artifacts, reject composition-bearing verification projections explicitly; never report a domain-only subset as whole-project verification.
compatibility: No legacy default cutover or authored schema change. Add the two exact compiler definition sources without changing any of the prior 38 pins. Domain module bytes and paths remain unchanged. Plan/capsule identities reflect the new compiler source set.
tests: source and snapshot public plans agree, including source deletion after snapshot
plain and application builds preserve all composition bytes and imports
project and node instantiation use exact shared views
native compilation and unchanged behavior in both layouts
invalid bindings, unsupported targets and stale or forged plans reject without writes
receipts detect missing, changed and surplus composition artifacts
stronger verification explicitly rejects unsupported composition coverage
